name: GradientBench briefs
authoringPolicy: Written by the Opal42 maintainers for this project. No copied or paraphrased third-party copy. Company, product and brand names are invented; any resemblance to a real organisation is coincidental and no endorsement is implied. Briefs describe a UI situation and never ask for a specific CSS gradient, so every model is free to choose its own colours. Constraint hex values are arbitrary design values, not trademarked brand colours. See docs/bench.md.

briefs.brief: Hero background for a project-management tool aimed at small design agencies. Calm, trustworthy, a little playful. A headline and a product screenshot sit on top.
Landing hero for an invoicing app for freelancers. Should feel quick and uncluttered; the background must not fight with a large white headline.
Hero section for a developer-observability platform. Technical but approachable; a slow, deep background behind a code sample card.
Hero for an HR onboarding product. Warm and human rather than corporate; text is dark and left-aligned.
Background for the sign-up page of a customer-support inbox. Energetic, confident; a form card is centred on top.
Hero for a data-privacy SaaS. Should signal safety and clarity without looking like a bank; headline is white.
Hero for a meeting-notes assistant. Soft, modern, a hint of colour in one corner only; lots of whitespace.
Pricing-page header band for a subscription analytics tool. Subtle, supports a three-column pricing grid below it.
Hero background for a calendar-scheduling tool for clinics. Clean and clinical but friendly; avoid the usual purple-to-blue look.
Full-bleed hero for an API-first email service. Dark theme, a glowing feel behind a terminal-style demo.
Seasonal banner for a ceramics shop: autumn collection. Earthy, warm, with room for a product photo on the right.
Free-shipping announcement bar across the top of a sneaker store. Thin, bold, must stay readable at 40px height.
Homepage banner for a plant nursery's spring sale. Fresh and light; text overlay in dark green.
Black Friday style banner for an electronics retailer, but tasteful. Dark base with one accent area.
Category banner for a children's book shop. Cheerful, soft, not neon.
Banner for a specialty coffee roaster's subscription offer. Rich and roasted; headline in cream.
Gift-card promotion tile for a boutique stationery store. Elegant, muted, slightly metallic feel without looking tacky.
Clearance banner for a furniture store. Calm, neutral base; the percentage-off badge is the loud element, not the background.
Back-to-school banner for an online bookstore. Friendly, bright, works on both desktop and a narrow phone crop.
Summer swimwear collection banner. Sunlit water feeling; keep contrast high for a white caption.
Revenue summary card in a finance dashboard: one big number and a small trend line. Subtle depth, not decorative.
Active-users KPI tile on an admin dashboard. Slight tint to separate it from neighbouring white cards.
Storage-usage card with a progress bar fill. The fill should read as 'getting fuller' toward the right.
Server-health status card that is currently healthy. Calm green family, text stays dark.
Support-queue card showing a backlog warning. Amber family; must not look like an error state.
Weekly goals card for a fitness dashboard. Motivating but restrained; works in a 3-column grid.
Card header strip for an analytics widget titled 'Conversion funnel'. Thin band, 48px tall.
Skeleton-loading shimmer for dashboard cards. A neutral grey sweep, no colour.
Profile card on a team dashboard with an avatar overlapping the top edge. The top cover area needs a background.
Dark-theme metric card for a trading dashboard showing a positive daily change. Subtle, no neon.
Splash screen for a meditation app. Slow, breathable, dusk colours; logo is a white glyph in the centre.
Launch screen for a bike-sharing app. Energetic, outdoors, daytime; must work in portrait on tall phones.
Splash for a language-learning app aimed at teenagers. Playful, saturated but not harsh.
Splash for a personal-finance app. Reassuring, deep, one dominant hue.
Onboarding screen background for a recipe app. Warm kitchen feel; text blocks at the bottom third.
Splash for a weather app. Should evoke early morning sky, top-to-bottom.
Launch screen for a podcast player. Dark, moody, a single glow behind the logo.
Loading screen background for a puzzle game on phones. Light and friendly, avoids looking like a stock gradient.
Splash for a sleep-tracking app. Night sky, very low brightness so it is gentle in a dark bedroom.
Splash for a pet-adoption app. Soft, cuddly, pastel; logo in dark plum.
Primary call-to-action button for a dark-mode developer tool. Subtle gradient with a visible hover state.
'Upgrade' button in a dark settings page. It should draw the eye without glowing.
Floating action button in a dark music app. Circular, 56px, needs a clear fill and a pressed state.
Pill-shaped 'Start free trial' button on a dark marketing site; white label.
Destructive 'Delete workspace' button in dark mode. Serious, not alarming.
Secondary outlined button in dark mode whose border uses a gradient.
Toggle switch track in dark mode, on state. Smooth, narrow, 24px tall.
Dark-theme 'Buy now' button for a game store. Confident, a little shine.
Segmented-control active segment in a dark dashboard. Understated lift from the track.
Dark-mode 'Record' button for a screen-capture tool. Red family, readable white icon.
A one-dimensional colour strip for a temperature legend from -10 to 40 degrees Celsius. Must read as ordered cold to hot.
Sequential scale strip for a population-density choropleth legend; light to dark, perceptually even.
Diverging strip for profit and loss, centred on zero, with neutral midpoint.
Heat strip beneath a calendar heatmap showing commit activity: none to very busy.
Air-quality index legend strip from good to hazardous, ordered, colour-blind-friendly.
Elevation legend strip for a topographic map, sea level to peaks.
Rainfall intensity strip for a weather radar legend; dry to torrential.
Sentiment strip from very negative to very positive for a survey dashboard, with a neutral centre.
Load-average strip for a server monitoring page: idle to saturated, readable in greyscale as well.
Sequential legend for a correlation matrix, 0 to 1 only, single hue family.
Landing page for a local farmers' market festival. Section dividers need background treatments; lively and warm.
Event page for an indie music night. Dusky, stage-light feeling behind the lineup list.
Landing page for a solar-panel installer. Optimistic, sunrise energy, but still credible.
Newsletter sign-up strip for a cooking blog; sits between two white sections, 200px tall.
Landing page for a yoga studio. Gentle, airy; a different soft background per section.
Crowdfunding page for a board game. Playful, bold, a hero and a stretch-goal band.
Webinar registration page for a cybersecurity training company. Serious, dark; a countdown sits on top.
Landing page for an electric-bike brand. Fresh and fast; a diagonal feeling to the hero background.
Footer call-to-action band for a nonprofit that plants trees. Natural, hopeful.
Landing page for a bakery's holiday pre-order. Cosy, warm, festive without clichés.
Health bar for a fantasy RPG. Full to empty reading left to right; must look good at 12px tall.
Mana bar for the same RPG; a different colour family from the health bar.
Main-menu background for a sci-fi strategy game. Deep space, a faint horizon glow.
Button for a puzzle game's 'Next level' screen. Candy-like, glossy but legible.
Loot rarity frames: common to legendary, as a set of gradient borders or fills.
Racing game speedometer arc fill, from calm to redline.
Dialogue box background for a cosy farming game. Parchment feeling, low contrast edges.
Pause overlay for a platformer that dims the scene but keeps it visible.
Experience-points bar for a mobile RPG with a golden theme.
Cooldown overlay on an ability icon in a MOBA, sweeping dark to transparent-feeling.
Hero background for Brightwell Mortgages, using only the brand palette; trustworthy and plain.
constraints: Use only the brand colours (tints and shades of them are fine).

briefs.brief: Banner for Fernhill Tea, a small organic tea company. Keep it recognisably on-brand.
App header for Northgate Transit, a regional bus operator. Must feel like their identity.
Newsletter header for Quillstone Books, an independent publisher.
constraints: Two brand colours only, no extra hues.

briefs.brief: Card background for Lumen Dental clinic's appointment widget.
constraints: Use the teal brand colour as the anchor.

briefs.brief: Landing hero for Cobalt & Co accounting, with a restrained look.
Promo banner for Marlow Outdoors, a camping-gear shop.
Splash for Peppermint Pay, a payments app.
constraints: Mint and charcoal; avoid adding other hues.

briefs.brief: Section background for Harbor Light Credit Union's annual report page.
constraints: Stay inside the blue family of the brand.

briefs.brief: Event ticket header for Saffron Street Food Festival.
constraints: Saffron and deep aubergine are the brand colours.

briefs.brief: Hero background behind 18px body text in #ffffff. All text must keep a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 across the whole gradient.
constraints: Contrast of at least 4.5:1 everywhere text sits.

briefs.brief: Card background behind #1a1a1a text. Must pass WCAG AA at every point.
constraints: WCAG AA contrast at every point.

briefs.brief: A status banner that must not rely on colour alone and stays readable for people with deuteranopia.
constraints: Avoid red-green as the only distinction.

briefs.brief: Low-vision friendly page header: high contrast, no banding, no subtle low-contrast sweeps.
Button with white label that must hit 4.5:1 against its fill at both ends of the gradient.
constraints: 4.5:1 at the lightest point of the fill.

briefs.brief: Reduced-motion friendly animated background: describe the static fallback and any animation.
Windows high-contrast mode friendly hero: describe how the decorative gradient behaves when forced colours are on.
constraints: Decorative gradients must not carry meaning.

briefs.brief: Form field focus highlight that remains visible against both light and dark pages.
Large-print notice board background for a care home display. Gentle, very legible, no fine detail.
Data legend strip readable in greyscale: the lightness must change steadily so order survives without hue.
constraints: Order must be readable in greyscale.
